subject: Addendum request: time-box topup vs. invoice offset for Silverline POC
messages:
From: Karen Liu <karen.liu@silverline.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short top-up or invoice offset for POC (Silverline)

Hi Markus,

Quick note from our side — we've burned through the initial 3-week POC window faster than expected due to a burst of internal testing (see attached usage_export_20260910.csv). We need to keep the runners-up tests going for another ~10 business days to finish the evaluation.

Our procurement team prefers applying any concession as an invoice offset or credit on the next invoice rather than ad-hoc invoices. That said, if Redwood prefers an addendum/time-box top-up we can accept that too — we'd just need clear pricing and an SOW change. Can you outline: 1) time-box top-up price for 10 business days, 2) equivalent credit amount if you were to apply an invoice offset, and 3) any one-time discount you can offer for the extension?

I've cc'd Marcus Hale (procurement) and Legal so they can flag any PO/SOW constraints. Attaching our draft SOW for reference.

Attachments (stubs): Silverline_SOW_draft_v2.pdf, usage_export_20260910.csv

Thanks,
Karen
Karen Liu
Head of Integrations, Silverline AI
karen.liu@silverline.ai
+1 415-555-0146
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@silverline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short top-up or invoice offset for POC (Silverline)

Hi Karen — thanks for the note and the usage export. Sorry you hit the burst so fast, but good news that the test coverage is strong.

High-level options we can do today:

1) Time-box addendum (fastest): 10 business days top-up priced at $10,500 flat (this preserves current SKU/throughput guarantees). We can issue a short addendum to your SOW and invoice upon signature.

2) Credit/invoice offset: We can issue a $11,000 credit to be applied as an offset against your next invoice (this is slightly more generous to account for variability in token consumption). The credit can be applied immediately once procurement signs the credit agreement.

3) Hybrid: 1-week immediate top-up ($5,500) + remaining days converted to a credit ($5,500) applied as invoice offset.

As a one-time concession for an engaged evaluation, we can offer a 5% one-time discount on the addendum price (applies to option 1 only) or increase the credit amount by 5% for option 2.

Logistics: Marissa (CS) will handle the addendum execution and concierge hours if you want help pushing tests. Jonas (account lead) will coordinate legal & billing details. Evelyn (support) is copied for any infra questions.

Next steps — confirm preferred option and whether procurement needs us to route via PO or via a credit memo so we can draft the right paperwork.

Attachments (stubs): addendum_term_sheet.pdf

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
From: Karen Liu <karen.liu@silverline.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@procurement.silverline.ai>, Silverline Legal <legal@silverline.ai>
Date: 2026-09-11T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short top-up or invoice offset for POC (Silverline)

Thanks Markus — appreciate the clear options. A couple of clarification asks from Procurement:

- Can the credit be split across two invoices if the evaluation extends into the next billing period?
- For the hybrid path, can the immediate 1-week top-up be invoiced and the credit portion issued as a credit memo (we prefer credits to be visible on the invoice run for reconciliation)?

Procurement preference is invoice offset (option 2) because our accounting workflow prevents ad-hoc small invoices mid-evaluation. If you can increase the credit to $11,500 (to cover any overrun) and confirm split-to-invoices is allowed, we can proceed quickly.

I've attached our PO template for your finance team to review. Legal flagged one small SOW edit (section 2.1 on data retention) — they prefer the addendum to reference the existing SOW rather than re-stating terms.

Attachments (stubs): procurement_PO_template.docx

Best,
Karen
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@silverline.ai>, Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@procurement.silverline.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short top-up or invoice offset for POC (Silverline)

Hi Karen / Marcus — looping in a quick itemized breakdown so procurement has numbers to compare: see attached pricing_breakdown.xlsx (stub).

Option 1 (10 business days): $10,500 list price
- 5% one-time concession if accepted by EOD 2026-09-16: -$525
- Effective total with concession: $9,975

Option 2 (credit/invoice offset): $11,000 credit value we initially proposed (covers variability); we can increase to $11,500 conditional on a short credit agreement signature (we can route as a credit memo). Credits can be split across up to 2 invoices for reconciliation purposes.

Hybrid: 1-week immediate top-up invoiced at $5,500 + $6,000 credit applied to next invoice.

Operational notes:
- We will include 8 hours of concierge onboarding at no extra charge if you sign the addendum (helps your test owners run regression batches).
- Legal edit: we will reference the existing SOW for data retention language (no restatement).
- If procurement needs a PO, we can accept a PO and issue a credit memo against that PO for option 2.

If invoice-offset (option 2) at $11,500 works for you, we'll prepare the credit agreement and get finance to queue the credit memo once countersigned. For quick momentum, the hybrid option lets you get an immediate week while finance processes credits.

Attachments (stubs): pricing_breakdown.xlsx

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@silverline.ai>, Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@procurement.silverline.ai>, Silverline Legal <legal@silverline.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Final proposal: invoice offset + immediate 1-week top-up (Silverline POC)

Hi Karen / Marcus — following the thread, here is our final, actionable proposal to keep your evaluation moving with minimal friction:

- Invoice offset: Redwood will issue an $11,500 credit memo (deal SL-2026-1763) that can be applied across up to two upcoming invoices. This requires a countersigned short credit agreement (we'll prepare).
- Immediate runway: We will also issue a 1-week time-box addendum (effective immediately) invoiced at $5,225 (this includes the 5% concession).
- Concierge: We will provide 8 hours of onboarding/throughput tuning at no additional cost and Evelyn will be the technical point-of-contact for execution.
- Legal/SOW: Our addendum will reference your existing SOW for data retention language per your request; redline attached.

Next steps:
1) Marcus / Legal: confirm you accept the credit memo flow and we will send the short credit agreement and redline addendum for signature.
2) If you need a PO to attach, send the PO to finance@redwoodinference.com and we'll match it to the credit memo.
3) Once countersigned, Marissa will schedule the 8-hour concierge block (Evelyn will follow up on availability).

DocuSign link (addendum & credit agreement): https://www.docusign.net/contract/SL-1763-addendum

Attachments (stubs): redline_addendum_Silverline.pdf

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps speed approvals.

Thanks,
